title: Frame app review as one standalone plugin example
summary: BCQuality documentation now presents the project as a general skill plugin model with app review as one example, removing code-review-specific framing and external orchestrator references.
key_points: Standalone installation explained as discovery and invocation of BCQuality skills
Complete app review repositioned as a concrete example of the walk-up pattern
Future skills documented to follow the same discovery pattern
Removed historical naming and external orchestrator references
Documentation refocused on BCQuality's own concepts and behavior
quote: Label complete app review as one concrete example of the walk-up pattern.
